title: Authentication refresh-token failures
body: Expired signing keys caused refresh-token validation failures for mobile sessions. Nia Brooks coordinated the response. The immediate mitigation reloaded the active key set, and the permanent action is automated key-set freshness monitoring.

title: Duplicate webhook deliveries
body: A worker timeout caused payment webhooks to be retried after successful delivery. Omar Haddad owns the follow-up. The team added idempotency-key enforcement and changed acknowledgement to occur after the delivery record commits.

title: Search results unavailable after index promotion
body: The production search alias pointed to an incomplete index after promotion. Amy Nguyen led mitigation by restoring the previous alias. The release checklist now requires document-count validation before alias switching.

title: Reliability review follow-up
body: The review prioritized search index validation over a planned cache rewrite. The team set September 19 as the deadline for the automated document-count release check.

title: Delayed analytics exports
body: Analytics exports were delayed when a large customer job exhausted worker concurrency. Luis Moreno introduced per-workspace concurrency limits. No customer data was lost, and queued exports completed after capacity recovered.

title: Notification preference cache drift
body: Some users received muted notifications because preference invalidation events were processed out of order. The mitigation rebuilt affected cache entries. The follow-up adds sequence-number validation to preference events.
